description: Routing-table proxy shell with multi-hop chains: compiles a readable profile into mihomo, xray or sing-box configuration, with a Web UI, a TUI and a browser extension. Tracks every prerelease.
notes: Run 'conch init <subscription URL>' to write a profile, then 'conch daemon', and open http://127.0.0.1:9277/ or run 'conch tui'. The kernels are downloaded and verified on first use.

conch keeps the profile and .env in %USERPROFILE%\.config\conch, kernels, geodata, subscriptions, rule lists and pairings in %USERPROFILE%\.local\share\conch, and state and logs in %USERPROFILE%\.local\state\conch (the XDG_* variables move them).
Files from versions before 0.0.33 in %APPDATA%\conch and %LOCALAPPDATA%\conch keep working from there; stop the daemon, then run 'conch migrate --dry-run' and 'conch migrate' to move them.
